answer.answer: Ujjwala 2.0 includes a special facility for migrant households [E01]. The predecessor programme (original PMUY launched in May 2016) established a transition to clean cooking fuel like LPG among rural and deprived families who traditionally relied on firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes, helping reduce health risks for women and minimize environmental pollution [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: Ujjwala 2.0 includes special facility for migrant households
The predecessor programme promoted clean cooking fuel like LPG among rural and deprived families who traditionally relied on firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes
This shift helps reduce health risks for women and minimizes environmental pollution
